exams.name: Aquatic Facility Operator
exams.blurb: Pool operator certification covering water chemistry, filtration, disinfection, regulations and risk management for aquatic venues.

exams.name: Certified Park and Recreation Executive
exams.blurb: Advanced examination for parks and recreation leaders covering strategic planning, policy, finance and organisational management.

exams.name: Certified Park and Recreation Professional
exams.blurb: Entry professional examination covering programming, operations, finance, human resources and communication in parks agencies.

exams.name: Certified Playground Safety Inspector
exams.blurb: Examination covering playground hazard identification, surfacing standards, audits and maintenance inspection documentation.

exams.name: NAB Core of Knowledge Examination
exams.body: National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards
exams.blurb: Shared examination for long-term care administrators covering leadership, finance, environment, resident care and compliance.

exams.name: NAB Home and Community Based Services Line of Service Examination
exams.body: National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards
exams.blurb: Line-of-service examination for administrators of home and community based service agencies serving older and disabled adults.

exams.name: NAB Nursing Home Administrator Line of Service Examination
exams.body: National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards
exams.blurb: Licensure examination component specific to skilled nursing facility administration, taken with the Core of Knowledge examination.

exams.name: NAB Residential Care and Assisted Living Line of Service Examination
exams.body: National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards
exams.blurb: Line-of-service examination for assisted living and residential care administrators, used by states that license the role.

exams.name: ICF ACC Credentialing Exam
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice examination for Associate Certified Coach applicants covering core competencies, ethics and coaching boundaries.

exams.name: ICF Advanced Certification in Team Coaching
exams.blurb: Advanced credential requiring team coaching education, supervised engagements and a dedicated team coaching examination.

exams.name: ICF Credentialing Exam
exams.blurb: Situational judgement and knowledge examination required for Professional and Master Certified Coach credential applicants.

exams.name: Certified Deaf Interpreter Examination
exams.body: Center for the Assessment of Sign Language Interpretation
exams.blurb: Knowledge and performance testing for deaf interpreters working alongside hearing interpreters in complex communication settings.

exams.name: National Interpreter Certification
exams.body: Center for the Assessment of Sign Language Interpretation
exams.blurb: Knowledge and performance examinations for American Sign Language interpreters, recognised nationally by the RID registry.

exams.name: National Board Examination – Arts Section
exams.body: International Conference of Funeral Service Examining Boards
exams.blurb: Funeral service licensure examination covering funeral directing, law, ethics, merchandising, counselling and business practice.

exams.name: National Board Examination – Sciences Section
exams.body: International Conference of Funeral Service Examining Boards
exams.blurb: Funeral service licensure examination covering embalming, restorative art, pathology, microbiology, anatomy and chemistry.

exams.name: Accredited Genealogist
exams.body: International Commission for the Accreditation of Professional Genealogists
exams.blurb: Region-specific accreditation requiring document work samples, a four-part written examination and an oral review.

exams.name: ASLTA Teacher Certification
exams.blurb: Tiered evaluation of American Sign Language teaching at qualified, professional and master levels using portfolios and interviews.

exams.name: Board Certified Coach
exams.blurb: Examination-based coaching credential with specialty areas in leadership, career, health and wellness, and life coaching.

exams.name: Board for Evaluation of Interpreters Certification
exams.body: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
exams.blurb: Written and performance sign language interpreter testing system adopted by several states beyond its originating jurisdiction.

exams.name: Certified Celebrant
exams.blurb: Training programme preparing funeral celebrants to design and lead personalised non-religious memorial and life tribute services.

exams.name: Certified Cemetery Executive
exams.body: International Cemetery, Cremation and Funeral Association
exams.blurb: Credential for cemetery managers covering grounds operations, trust funds, sales, regulation and consumer protection rules.

exams.name: Certified Crematory Operator
exams.blurb: Operator training and examination covering cremation equipment, identification procedures, records, safety and regulation.

exams.name: Certified Funeral Service Practitioner
exams.body: Academy of Professional Funeral Service Practice
exams.blurb: Points-based continuing education credential recognising ongoing professional development by licensed funeral directors.

exams.name: Certified Genealogist
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed portfolio credential assessing research planning, source citation, evidence analysis and written case reports.

exams.name: Certified Healthcare Interpreter
exams.blurb: Written and oral examinations certifying spoken-language interpreters working in clinical and patient-facing healthcare settings.

exams.name: Certified Image Consultant
exams.blurb: Credential assessing competence in appearance, behaviour and communication consulting through examination and portfolio review.

exams.name: Certified Medical Interpreter
exams.body: National Board of Certification for Medical Interpreters
exams.blurb: Written and oral certification for medical interpreters covering terminology, ethics, standards of practice and cultural mediation.

exams.name: Certified Personal Chef
exams.blurb: Credential for in-home chefs combining culinary skill assessment with food safety, menu planning and small business practice.

exams.name: Certified Pool/Spa Operator
exams.blurb: Widely recognised pool operator course and examination on water chemistry, circulation, safety and health code compliance.

exams.name: Certified Preplanning Consultant
exams.blurb: Programme for advance funeral planning staff covering products, trust and insurance funding, ethics and consumer regulation.

exams.name: Certified Professional Organizer
exams.body: Board of Certification for Professional Organizers
exams.blurb: Experience-qualified examination covering assessment, organising systems, productivity coaching and professional ethics.

exams.name: Certified Professional Photographer
exams.blurb: Written examination plus an image submission review assessing technical control, lighting and post-production competence.

exams.name: Certified Professional Résumé Writer
exams.body: Professional Association of Résumé Writers & Career Coaches
exams.blurb: Two-part examination and résumé submission review assessing writing, keyword strategy and applicant tracking system awareness.

exams.name: Child Passenger Safety Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Standardised course with written and hands-on skills testing on car seat selection, installation and caregiver education.

exams.name: Educational Interpreter Performance Assessment
exams.blurb: Video-based performance and written assessment rating sign language interpreters who work in elementary and secondary classrooms.

exams.name: HUD Certified Housing Counselor Examination
exams.body: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
exams.blurb: Required examination covering financial management, property maintenance, fair housing, tenancy and avoiding foreclosure.

exams.name: National Braille Transcriber Certification
exams.body: National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled
exams.blurb: Course and manuscript examination certifying transcribers in literary, mathematics or music braille production standards.

exams.name: Nationally Certified Résumé Writer
exams.blurb: Rigorous examination and document review assessing résumé strategy, writing quality, formatting and career storytelling.
